## Reproduction

List the steps and whether the issue persists after a full restart. Only repeat save-changing steps on a separately backed-up test copy.

## Backup and recovery state

Is a separate whole-save backup available? What does the Add Save Slots panel report? Preserve existing save and archive files; do not delete them to clear an error.

## Redacted evidence

Include relevant error text or a redacted log excerpt. Do not attach personal saves, complete character archives, account identifiers, or unredacted private paths to this public issue.
